scope: Real loopback Go control-plane + sandboxed Chromium; exports are frozen backend artifacts, not live traffic or runtime evidence.

first-use endpoint: two imported connections are only routed by an explicit user choice
first-use direct: two imported connections are only routed by an explicit user choice
existing strategy groups remain editable and revoked recovery replaces only the selected client link
workspace: explicit publication changes only one of two independent client links
legacy-profile: explicit publication changes only one of two independent client links
saving a draft leaves frozen advanced published summary and delivery unchanged
invalid JSON, cancel, and Back retain the draft until an explicit retry succeeds
invalid and mismatched deep-link scope never silently selects a different configuration

scoped configuration creates one independent second-client subscription and immediately exposes its new link
same rule counts are not represented as identical routing when rule contents changed
25 synthetic configurations and 100 independent links remain searchable, bounded, and explicitly scoped
reviews material source changes and preserves accepted options until an explicit decision
imports directly into a configuration, retains a failed source, and saves only the draft
mobile navigation and cancellation preserve a useful return path
